what: K-Fold Cross Validation for Factor Analysis
title: K-Fold Cross Validation for Factor Analysis
text: kfa provides utilities examining dimensionality set variables foster scale development. Harnessing k-fold cross-validation approach, kfa helps researchers compare possible factor structures identify structures plausible replicable across samples.

title: K-Fold Cross Validation for Factor Analysis
code: # From CRAN install.packages("kfa")  # Development version install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("knickodem/kfa")  library(kfa)

title: K-Fold Cross Validation for Factor Analysis
text: two primary functions kfa() kfa_report(). set potential variables (optionally) maximum number factors, m, supplied kfa(), function: (requested) conducts power analysis determine number folds, k, split data training testing samples creates k folds (.e. training testing samples). fold: calculates sample statistics (e.g., correlation matrix, thresholds [necessary]) training sample. runs 2:m factor exploratory factor analysis (EFA) models using sample statistics, applies rotation (specified), extracts factor structure confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). structure 1-factor CFA also defined. runs 1:m factor CFA models testing sample. factor analyses run using lavaan package many lavaan estimation missing data options available use kfa(). kfa() returns list lists k outer elements fold m inner elements replicable factor model, containing lavaan object. expedite running k x m x 2 (EFA CFA) models, function utilizes parallel foreach packages parallel processing. kfa_report() aggregates CFA model fit, parameter estimates, model-based reliability across folds factor structure extracted kfa(). results organized exported via rmarkdown, example report run .
code: library(kfa) # simulate data based on a 3-factor model with standardized loadings sim.mod <- "f1 =~ .7*x1 + .8*x2 + .3*x3 + .7*x4 + .6*x5 + .8*x6 + .4*x7                 f2 =~ .8*x8 + .7*x9 + .6*x10 + .5*x11 + .5*x12 + .7*x13 + .6*x14                 f3 =~ .6*x15 + .5*x16 + .9*x17 + .4*x18 + .7*x19 + .5*x20                 f1 ~~ .2*f2                 f2 ~~ .2*f3                 f1 ~~ .2*f3                 x9 ~~ .2*x10" set.seed(1161) sim.data <- simstandard::sim_standardized(sim.mod,                                           n = 900,                                           latent = FALSE,                                           errors = FALSE)[c(2:9,1,10:20)]  # include a custom 2-factor model custom2f <- paste0("f1 =~ ", paste(colnames(sim.data)[1:10], collapse = " + "),                    "\nf2 =~ ",paste(colnames(sim.data)[11:20], collapse = " + "))  mods <- kfa(data = sim.data,             k = NULL,    # NULL prompts power analysis to determine number of folds             custom.cfas = custom2f  # can be a single object or named list             ) # Run report kfa_report(models = mods,            file.name = "example_sim_kfa_report",            report.title = "K-fold Factor Analysis - Example Sim",            report.format = "html_document")

title: Write confirmatory factor analysis syntax — efa_cfa_syntax

text: variables data.frame (convertible data.frame) variables factor analyze columns observations rows. power analysis assumes observations complete data.
